citation.title: Simultaneous analysis of ion and electron heat transport by power modulation in JET
citation.authors: F. Ryter, C. Angioni, C. Giroud, A.G. Peeters, T. Biewer, R. Bilato, E. Joffrin, T. Johnson, H. Leggate, E. Lerche, G. Madison, P. Mantica, D. Van Eester, I. Voitsekhovitch and JET Contributors

topic: Perturbative ion and electron heat transport in JET L-mode, studied with 3He-minority ICRH power modulation, CXRS Ti and ECE Te Fourier analysis, critical-gradient ASTRA modelling and GYRO simulations.
own_question: Can Ti modulation yield ion stiffness and threshold, and does ITG-driven off-diagonal transport shape the electron modulation?
actual_method_and_evidence: Offline Fourier amplitude and phase analysis of modulated core Ti from CXRS (10 ms frames in 2006, 4-20 Hz scan) and Te from ECE. The measured profiles are compared with critical-gradient-model simulations in ASTRA and with local GYRO runs. This is not pedestal work, not KSTAR, and involves no nowcasting, BES/ECEI inputs or online use.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: JET CXRS ion temperature has been acquired at 10 ms exposure, enough for offline Fourier analysis of 4-20 Hz modulation.
claim_checks.qualification: Applies to core CXRS in a JET L-mode with offline frame grouping. It says nothing about report latency, pedestal chords or KSTAR.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Offline FFT over intervals of about 1.5 s. No causal or real-time element and no measured report arrival times.
validation_if_relevant: Model-experiment profile matching only. No held-out data.
forbidden_inferences: Do not imply CES/CXRS nowcasting or report-latency evidence.
Do not transfer the core-transport results to pedestal-top behaviour or to KSTAR.
Do not present the ITG off-diagonal electron transport result as a physical mechanism for our model.
Do not treat the main-ion versus impurity Ti distinction as resolved by this source; the paper does not address it.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Exclude or cite only marginally. It could anchor one background sentence on time-resolved CXRS Ti use in transport studies, but it does not inform causal nowcasting, BES/ECEI incremental information or the validation designs.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
